title: F1 Ordered Stagger — Symbolic Sequential Motion Refinement

design_intent.director_anchor: One-after-another motion is symbolically meaningful because sequential progression represents the application identity.
design_intent.identity_statement: Kymaean's motion signature should communicate succession: one change enters, then another, then another. The sequence is a brand-level metaphor for continuity through time, not an automatic claim that the local interface elements are causally dependent.
design_intent.design_sol_anchor: Preserve the Director-selected symbolic succession while retaining the strongest benefit of the F4 alternative: temporal character should remain controlled, coherent and non-theatrical rather than becoming a generic cascading UI flourish.

required: A strict, legible onset sequence exists: item 1 begins before item 2, item 2 before item 3, and so on.
All items use the same movement duration, displacement within a context, easing, opacity, scale and rotation.
The identity mechanism is onset succession only; no hold, opacity modulation, token-specific duration split, reverse travel, bounce, spring or overshoot is introduced.
The same timing vector is used in WEB and APP-like contexts; context restraint is achieved through displacement amplitude, not by changing the sequence grammar.
Replay/trigger behavior may not delay content availability or task completion.
forbidden_mutations: custom continuous velocity profile as the primary mechanism

symbolic_brand_sequence.meaning: Succession is used as a metaphor for Kymaean's temporal identity: the experience develops through one-after-another change.
allowed_when: the moving elements are visual peers or a deliberately ordered brand/explanatory sequence
the user does not need to infer a functional state, completion percentage, priority, or causal dependency from the onset order
content/function is already available independently of observing the motion
the transition occurs at an identity-bearing boundary rather than continuously choreographing every UI update

literal_sequence.conditional_rule: Ordered stagger may accompany actual sequential product semantics only when the underlying product state independently proves that same order. In that case motion reflects truth; it may not invent the truth.
requires: the semantic order is sourced from authoritative product/runtime state
the visual order matches the semantic order
reduced-motion users receive the same order/state information without motion

prohibited_false_semantics: implied task-completion sequence when tasks are actually parallel
implied causal commit or consequence ordering not present in product state
any functional wait introduced solely to preserve choreography

logical_order_and_localization.default: Sequence follows declared logical/DOM order rather than being hard-coded to physical left-to-right position.
logical_order_and_localization.rtl_rule: For locale-responsive peer sequences, visual onset follows the locale-appropriate logical reading order unless the product data declares an independent chronological order.
logical_order_and_localization.numbered_or_chronological_content: When items already carry an authoritative order, follow that order exactly rather than mirroring for decoration.

refinement_matrix.purpose: Compare cadence inside F1 without reopening family selection. Isolate onset interval and equal per-item movement duration while holding F1 mechanism, easing and context displacement fixed.

F1B_REFERENCE.provenance: Exact Director-preferred MOT-01 F1 reference mechanism.

secondary_reference.role: Non-competing reference only. Render the already-frozen F4 timing in the same WEB/APP and WIDE/REFLOW_320 contexts to test whether an F1 refinement becomes needlessly generic, abrupt or theatrical relative to the strongest alternative.

refinement_matrix.reduced_motion: Apply the frozen immediate-final-state reduced-motion behavior to all 16 as a mandatory alternate preflight state; it is not an identity-scored variant.

group_size_boundary.why: The Director preference arose from the exact four-token F1 packet. Timing refinement must first preserve that perception before generalizing to arbitrary list lengths.
group_size_boundary.not_yet_authorized: Do not infer that every list, menu, grid, feed or large group should receive per-item stagger. Group-size/batching law is a later implementation concern after a cadence is selected.

process: Design Sol reviews the labeled comparison first and records its independent ranking/tradeoffs.
The Director views the same comparison and records product meaning, preference and any disagreement.
Design Sol reconciles both views and records the final Director-bound resolution where subjective evidence does not decide.

criteria.A1_symbolic_sequence_clarity: Does the one-after-another identity remain immediately perceptible without requiring explanation?
criteria.A2_cross_surface_restraint: Does APP remain materially restrained while preserving the same sequence grammar as WEB?
criteria.A3_generic_ui_cascade_risk: Does the motion still feel intentional/ownable rather than like a default list entrance?
criteria.A4_false_literal_semantics_risk: Would the cadence plausibly imply loading, priority, completion or causality when used at an identity-bearing boundary?
criteria.A5_temporal_drag: Does the sequence complete promptly enough that the brand signature never feels like waiting?
criteria.A6_f4_reference_check: Does F1 retain the Director-valued symbolic advantage while approaching F4's composure and temporal coherence?

direct_adjudication.tie_rule: If two F1 variants are mechanically clean and Design Sol cannot establish a material evidence advantage, the Director's preference is binding.

hard_preflight: All FULL variants preserve exact F1 mechanism invariants.
All variants finish from first onset to final completion in under 1.0 second.
No autoplay, looping, flash, bounce, overshoot, scale, rotation or scroll-linked movement.
Replay/focus remains stationary and keyboard-operable in the fixture.
No horizontal overflow or clipping at REFLOW_320.
Reduced-motion state creates no scored animation and loses no content/function/state information.
WEB and APP timing vectors are byte-equivalent per variant; only displacement differs.
F4 reference bytes/timing remain the already-frozen reference and are not silently retuned.

outcome_law.clean_single_preference: Adopt the preferred F1 cadence as a provisional refinement reference, not a production token system.
outcome_law.clean_tie: Director chooses among the tied F1 cadences after Design Sol presents tradeoffs.
outcome_law.all_f1_variants_fail_hard_preflight: Do not revert automatically to F4 and do not invent a fourth F1 cadence. Preserve F1 as the conceptual incumbent and open a separate correction decision explaining which hard invariant failed.
outcome_law.f4_becomes_subjectively_preferred_again: F4 cannot silently replace the Director-selected F1 incumbent. Design Sol must present the conflict directly to the Director as a new adjudication.

next_gate.work: Materialize the deterministic 16-specimen F1 refinement comparison, pass structural/reduced-motion preflight, then present the labeled F1A/F1B/F1C + F4 reference comparison for direct Design Sol + Director adjudication.

checks: Director-selected F1 mechanism preserved rather than redesigned
one-after-another symbolism made explicit as product identity input
symbolic succession separated from false literal causality
F4 retained as secondary reference without reopening family selection
three cadence variants bracket the existing 90/520 reference instead of post-result rerolling
direct Director + Design Sol adjudication law used without false blind-review claims
Q-DESIGN-02 Stage-motion block and engineering/E0 blind scoring remain untouched
